ns2:section.sectionText: Math 347 is restricted to students currently in majors requiring the course. ...... Students hoping to transfer to Math&CS who meet ALL the following requirements: last eligible term to apply to Math&CS is Fall 2019, completed or currently enrolled in CS 173, completed or currently enrolled in Math 231, overall GPA is at least 3.5--may fill out https://go.math.illinois.edu/FA19Math347 by April 19 to request an override that may be given between April 23-26. ...... Students hoping to transfer to Mathematics should email mathadvising@illinois.edu for course advising. ..... Major restrictions will be removed during business hours on May 1, 2019 for math minors and all other students. Some seats are reserved for off-campus math transfer students and will not be released until business hours on the Friday before fall classes begin.
